label: Bible Study
prompt: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will _____ their sin no more.
verse: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
note: The new covenant's finale — a God who chooses not to bring our sins back up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall _____, and your joy no man taketh from you.
verse: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
note: Sorrow now, joy later — and Jesus promises a joy that no one can take away once it comes.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And through a _____ in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verse: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
note: Paul's escape from Damascus in his own words: let down through a window in a basket over the wall (Acts 9:25).

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I will shake all nations, and the _____ of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: Haggai promises God will shake the nations and fill the humble second temple with glory.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no _____, the strife ceaseth.
verse: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
note: No wood, no fire; no 'talebearer,' no strife. Starve gossip of fuel and quarrels go out on their own.
